zh.title: 漢莎航空首架A350-1000完成首次試飛　採用百週年紀念塗裝
zh.summary: 首架預定交付漢莎航空的Airbus A350-1000於10月5日在土魯斯完成首次試飛，採用百週年紀念塗裝，交付後將註冊為D-AIFA並命名為「Deutschland」。
body: 首架預定交付漢莎航空（Lufthansa）的空中巴士A350-1000，於2026年10月5日在法國土魯斯完成首次試飛。該機已採用漢莎航空百週年紀念塗裝，目前使用測試註冊編號F-WZNY，交付後將以D-AIFA註冊，並命名為「Deutschland」（德國）。
該機自土魯斯布拉尼亞克機場（TLS）起飛，飛往比斯開灣一帶進行測試，約3個半小時後返回土魯斯。此次飛行屬於交付前的測試程序，尚未投入漢莎航空的定期航班營運。
機身以深藍色為主色，搭配大型白色鶴鳥標誌，以及「1926 | 2026」與「100」字樣。漢莎航空已於今年7月公布這架飛機的塗裝；它也是公司百週年紀念塗裝計畫中的第七架飛機。
漢莎航空訂購了15架A350-1000，預計於2030年前陸續交付。這款長程廣體客機機身長73.8公尺，比A350-900長約7公尺；漢莎規劃配置300個座位，涵蓋頭等艙、商務艙、豪華經濟艙與經濟艙。首架飛機交付時，亦將成為空中巴士交付漢莎航空集團的第700架航空器。

en.title: Lufthansa's First A350-1000 Completes Maiden Test Flight in Centenary Livery
en.summary: The first Airbus A350-1000 destined for Lufthansa completed its first test flight from Toulouse on October 5 wearing the airline's centenary livery. It will be registered D-AIFA and named 'Deutschland' after delivery.
body: The first Airbus A350-1000 scheduled for delivery to Lufthansa completed its maiden test flight from Toulouse, France, on October 5, 2026. The aircraft already wears Lufthansa's centenary livery and currently carries the Airbus test registration F-WZNY. After delivery, it will be registered D-AIFA and named 'Deutschland.'

The aircraft departed Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) and flew toward the Bay of Biscay for testing before returning to Toulouse about three and a half hours later. The flight formed part of the pre-delivery test program, and the aircraft has not yet entered scheduled Lufthansa service.

The fuselage is finished primarily in dark blue with a large white crane logo as well as '1926 | 2026' and '100' markings. Lufthansa revealed the design in July, and this aircraft is the seventh in the airline's centenary special-livery program.

Lufthansa has ordered 15 A350-1000s, with deliveries planned through 2030. The long-haul widebody is 73.8 meters long, around seven meters longer than the A350-900. Lufthansa plans a 300-seat configuration with first class, business class, premium economy and economy. When delivered, the first A350-1000 will also become the 700th Airbus aircraft delivered to the Lufthansa Group.

airports: 土魯斯布拉尼亞克機場
